## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Local SEO & Google 3-Pack Optimization
- **Focus**: Elevating local contractors, clinics, legal firms, and multi-location businesses into the top 3 Google Maps results.
- **Key Methodologies**: Geo-grid proximity analysis, primary category optimization, NAP citation synchronization across 80+ directories, geotagged photo metadata, review velocity funnels, and localized service area pages.
- **Typical Outcomes**: 320%+ surge in high-intent inbound calls and direction requests within 90 days.

### 2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Search Citation
- **Focus**: Establishing brand authority and citations in AI search engines including ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini, and Perplexity AI.
- **Key Methodologies**: Nested JSON-LD schema entity graphs, digital PR citations, Wikidata alignment, and natural language question-answer content clustering.

### 3. Paid Ads Management (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads, LinkedIn)
- **Focus**: Generating high-ROI customer acquisition with multi-channel paid funnels.
- **Key Methodologies**: Search & Performance Max campaigns on Google Ads, dynamic creative testing on Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok Ads, server-side Conversions API (CAPI) tracking, and dedicated landing page CRO.
- **Typical Outcomes**: 3.5x to 7.2x verified Return On Ad Spend (ROAS).

### 4. Custom Next.js & React Web Engineering
- **Focus**: Ultra-fast Jamstack websites and web applications engineered for 95+ Core Web Vitals and frictionless conversion flows.
- **Technologies**: Next.js App Router, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, Headless CMS (Strapi, Sanity, Shopify, WordPress).

### 5. AI Chatbot Integration & Lead Qualification
- **Focus**: Deploying 24/7 automated qualification and appointment booking chatbots integrated with WhatsApp, CRM, and website chat interfaces.

## Case Studies & Outcomes
- **Vancouver Home Services / Contractor**: Scaled from rank #14 (Page 2+) to consistent #1 Google 3-Pack rank across Vancouver and Lower Mainland neighborhood areas, generating 340% increase in inbound calls.
- **E-Commerce Fashion Brand**: Scaled paid social ROAS from 1.8x to 4.9x using Meta CAPI server-side tracking, UGC video creatives, and TikTok spark ads.
- **B2B SaaS Platform**: Built high-speed Next.js web application with integrated RAG AI demo, lifting demo signup conversion rates by 48%.
